enrichment.summary: The district is hiring Nor Cal Moving Services of Hayward to move free-standing furniture from the first floor to the second floor at 1011 Union Street in Oakland. This is part of the Central Office Consolidation Move Project. The moving date is May 23, 2024, and the cost is paid from the Measure Y building fund.

enrichment.headline: Sets Overaa Construction's Phase 1 Roosevelt Middle School modernization price at $3.67M
enrichment.summary: This amendment to a lease-leaseback contract (a construction arrangement where the district leases the site to the builder and leases it back) with Overaa Construction of Richmond sets the Total Sublease Amount for Phase 1 of the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project at $3,671,887. That total includes set-aside allowances for items such as PG&E service work, site preparation, pre-construction services and security services, plus contractor and district contingencies. The text does not state how much this adds to the earlier amount, and all other contract terms stay in effect.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
